description: Error messages reveal sensitive system information or implementation details. This signal indicates that error handling may expose information useful to attackers.
applicability: Applicable to all applications and systems generating error messages. Includes web application errors, API responses, and system error logs visible to users.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through error handling review, error message analysis, and information disclosure testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Information Integrity
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
